title: Competitive Thermostat: model latency-price crosswalk and action runbook
creator: Lena Park
description: Purpose: build a repeatable 'thermostat' artifact that maps competing model variants across latency, per-token price, and fallback quality so PMs and SalesOps can quickly decide provision vs. hosted fallbacks. This ticket pulls together: (1) a prioritized crosswalk spreadsheet, (2) a short decision runbook with action triggers (e.g., when to switch to quantized variants, when to route to dedicated capacity), and (3) a minimal dashboard to monitor the key signals. Scope: - surface 8 candidate model families (open & commercial) across three regions (us-east, eu-west, ap-sg) - compute representative p50/p95 token latency at 512/1024 seq lengths and normalized per-token cost for our hosting tiers - score fallback quality delta using the existing eval harness (prompt set A/B) Deliverables: 1) Crosswalk CSV + scoring methodology 2) Runbook (play-by-play triggers and stakeholders) 3) Dashboard prototype with alert rules 4) Short internal memo for Sales and Solutions. Success metrics: - <24h decision templates for 80% of common enterprise fallback scenarios - dashboard shows live latency/cost delta for top 3 model families per region - adoption of runbook by 2 pilot customer success tracks by end of cycle
